structured_patch_proposals.blocking_issue: control_plane.py:60 POSIX mode-0700 check breaks 39/48 tests (100% of QueueTests & FileTests) on Windows NTFS.
structured_patch_proposals.evidence: Reproduced on Windows Python 3.14.3 against eea64f4: mkdir(mode=0o700) succeeds but NTFS stat().st_mode returns 0o40777, so (p.stat().st_mode & 0o077) != 0 raises ValueError('Private root must have mode 0700') on every Coordinator and FileReceipts init.
structured_patch_proposals.proposed_change: Guard the POSIX bitmask check with `if os.name == 'posix' and (p.stat().st_mode & 0o077): raise ValueError(...)` while preserving the `.git` worktree ancestry rejection and symlink check unconditionally on all OSes.
structured_patch_proposals.acceptance_test: QueueTests (28/28) and FileTests (11/11) initialize private_root on both Linux (enforcing 0700 rejection if chmod 0755) and Windows NTFS without ValueError; inside-repo path still raises ValueError on both OSes.

structured_patch_proposals.blocking_issue: file_receipts.py:66-68 directory os.open(..., O_RDONLY) + os.fsync() raises PermissionError [Errno 13] on Windows.
structured_patch_proposals.evidence: After fixing WIN-B1, 8/11 FileTests fail in FileReceipts.publish() at line 66 (`d = os.open(self.receipts, os.O_RDONLY)`) with `PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied` because Win32 does not allow opening a directory with POSIX O_RDONLY/fsync.
structured_patch_proposals.proposed_change: Guard directory fsync with `if os.name == 'posix':` (retaining file-level `os.fsync(f.fileno())` before `os.link` on all platforms), and add `O_CREAT | O_EXCL` fallback if `os.link` fails with ENOTSUP/EPERM on non-hardlink filesystems.
structured_patch_proposals.acceptance_test: All 11/11 FileTests pass on Windows NTFS and Linux ext4, including restart/replay, conflict immutability, orphan `.partial-*` handling, and corruption detection.

key_findings.verdict: Claude's <=3-vx normal correspondence cleanly separates adjacent windings on fitted (2.35% vs 97.54% in 64-vx cells) and flat (4.39% vs 97.44%) meshes. However, m7 snapping collapses distinct adjacent windings onto the same m7 ridge: mean adjacent <=3-vx overlap jumps 15.2x vs fitted (to 35.74%; w034->w035 hits 59.01%, median 3.24 vx; even step-2 w034->w036 jumps from 0.32% to 26.59%). Implication: (1) post-snap <=3-vx dedup genuinely prevents redundant ink inference on collapsed patches, (2) m7 snap MUST NEVER be used for physical coverage accounting or sheet identity because it silently skips the original sheet (w034 leaves its own sheet and jumps onto w035/winner).

s0_19scroll_inventory.scope_note: Sanitized scroll-level aggregates only (zero unread coordinates, zero crop bounds, zero selected axial band indices). S0 clean_fraction orders bands WITHIN a scroll only; it is not a cross-scroll ink probability.

first_letters_50k_prize.rationale: Full dense-fit across 190 bands requires 1,748-2,888 L4-h vs ~140 L4-h remaining (12.5-20.6x over budget). A01 S0+S1 cuts initial 19-scroll screening area from ~190,000 cm^2 to ~2,280 cm^2 (83x reduction), costing ~16.5 L4-h (both orders) or ~9.5 L4-h (1-order+15% audit) on L4, or 0 cloud L4-h on local RTX 4060 (~77-99 wall hours at safe laptop thermal profile). Crucial synergy: offload S2/S4 inference on pre-existing clean meshes (PHerc0125 pscamillo, PHerc1203 S3, flattened PHerc0826/0191) to local RTX 4060 ($0 cloud budget) so the entire ~140 L4-h Colab budget is conserved strictly for S5 dense fits where S0+S1 justify them (~17-25 dense fits instead of 9-15).

nov_30_progress_prize_6_days_remaining.rationale: With 6 days until Nov 30, deploying a multi-host SQLite coordinator or waiting on R2 120-map statistical benchmarks yields ZERO Nov 30 Progress Prize value and diverts GPU/engineering time from finalizing/submitting the already-verified 18-receipt FP16 + source-support + Exp T1-T17 dossier. Conversely, our lightweight cross-platform R1 FileReceipts adapter, Windows compatibility patches, S0 19-scroll joined table, and the PHerc. 0211 snap2 winding-collapse dedup measurement take <1 CPU day, risk zero GPU downtime, and directly strengthen engineering rigor for both tracks.
